"""Experiment-only evidence model override; application remains unchanged."""
import hashlib
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
from langchain_openrouter import ChatOpenRouter
from stone_shelter_assistant.assistant import workflow
from stone_shelter_assistant.assistant.candidate_evaluation import CandidateEvidence
from stone_shelter_assistant.assistant.reference_evidence import ReferenceEvidence
from stone_shelter_assistant.core.settings import OpenRouterSettings

@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def isolated_evidence_model_override(request, monkeypatch):
    if request.node.name != 'test_questions_challenge_20_live':
        return
    from tests.integration import test_questions_challenge_20_live as runner
    original_structured = workflow.structured_model
    original_persist = runner._persist
    terra = ChatOpenRouter(model_name='openai/gpt-6.1-terra',openrouter_api_key=OpenRouterSettings().api_key,max_tokens=8192,max_retries=0,request_timeout=180_000)
    def structured(model, schema, **kwargs):
        if schema in (CandidateEvidence, ReferenceEvidence):
            model=terra
            kwargs['use_json_schema']=True
        return original_structured(model,schema,**kwargs)
    def persist(path,result):
        result['experiment']={
            'id':'PY-057','base_git_revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'runtime_state':'uncommitted fixes; per-round source snapshot archived','round':int(os.environ['STONE_EXPERIMENT_ROUND']),'maximum_rounds':5,'source_snapshot':os.environ['STONE_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT'],
            'purpose':'Luna throughout; Terra for evidence extraction in four complex scenarios.',
            'actual_stage_models':{'parse_question':'openai/gpt-6-luna','ground_question':'openai/gpt-6-luna','select_candidates':'openai/gpt-6-luna','evaluate_candidates':'openai/gpt-6.1-terra','collect_reference_evidence':'openai/gpt-6.1-terra','answer':'openai/gpt-6-luna'},
            'note':'HTTP model_ids/request_models describe shared Luna settings. The experiment-only structured_model override replaces only CandidateEvidence/ReferenceEvidence generation with Terra; generation telemetry is authoritative for executed calls.',
            'harness_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            'harness_archive':'PY-057-evidence-model-harness.py.txt',
        }
        original_persist(path,result)
    monkeypatch.setattr(workflow,'structured_model',structured)
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner,'_persist',persist)
